search_scope: Four verified sources supporting the endpoint-controlled intermediate-code-path branch; metadata verification only in this addition.

sources.title: Revision-Aware Success Prediction from Multi-Attempt Programming Trajectories
sources.status: arXiv version 1 preprint; peer-reviewed venue unverified

date_evidence.reason: Primary page history reports July while the arXiv identifier and some indexes indicate August; retain year-only in citation.

evidence.finding: Same-problem current, next-attempt and short-window acceptance targets; current/pair/multi-snapshot regimes have different eligible sets.
Trajectory construction, input regimes and limitations; not an endpoint-controlled next-different-problem first-response experiment.

caveats: Citation year only because source dates are not internally consistent; no month/day asserted in bibliography.
Model comparisons do not hold the eligible cohort constant across all history regimes.
Human-AI contest setting must not be treated as novice classroom evidence without qualification.

sources.title: srcML-DKT: Enhancing Deep Knowledge Tracing with Robust Code Representations from srcML
sources.status: EDM 2025 published short paper, proceedings pages 541–548

evidence.finding: Code representation handles unparsable submissions; evaluations distinguish first and all attempts.
Consecutive-code case study; no endpoint-versus-intermediate nuisance-controlled contrast identified in inspected text.

caveats: Page anchors refer to the archived eight-page author manuscript; bibliographic pages come from the official proceedings BibTeX.
No source-code reproduction in this audit.

sources.title: HELP-DKT: an interpretable cognitive model of how students learn programming based on deep knowledge tracing
sources.status: Scientific Reports published journal article, volume 12, article 4012

evidence.finding: Next-challenge prediction from code history is prior art; Task A uses a three-attempt criterion, not next-problem first-response correctness.

caveats: Article number 4012 is not a page range.
Repository URL is stated in the article; repository implementation was not inspected in this audit.
No complete endpoint/count/time/outcome-matched path ablation identified in the inspected article.

sources.title: Open-ended Knowledge Tracing for Programming Exercises
sources.status: 6th Educational Data Mining in Computer Science Education (CSEDM) Workshop paper, archived on Zenodo

evidence.finding: First-submission training/evaluation and all-submission settings differ; first-only setting excludes revisions, not an intermediate-path increment on fixed first-response targets.

caveats: This record cites the inspected eight-page CSEDM workshop version, not the separately titled EMNLP 2022 full paper mentioned in its footnote.
No proceedings page range independently verified; omitted.
Repository creation date is distinct from publication date, not used as the publication year.
